changes.reason: THE-UNRUN-SUITE: the integration-tagged suites had no gate. make verify type-checks them (vet-integration) and runs nothing, so a profile that stopped running, or ran red, changed no visible fact — which is how a broken bundle fixture stayed latent for a slice and a wrong advertised algorithm list for two days with a test on the right side sitting red. The owner ruled for a SEPARATE make verify-integration with its own gate-witness record (GATE-RUN.integration.txt, gitignored like the e2e-full record), wired into the two-repo mint where a database already stands up, leaving make verify database-free and runnable without Docker. The rule pins the judgement and the wiring: three outcomes with three distinct exit codes and only green at zero, a run that executes ZERO tests refused, a failing run refused, a missing database CANNOT-EVALUATE at exit 2 and never a pass, the witness executed as a built binary because go run collapses exit 2 into 1, the mint running the gate and re-checking its record, and make verify staying free of it. Mutation red-proved twice — the zero-test guard disabled turned a suite that never ran green, and the no-database classification disabled reported an absent environment as a red tree
